The quest for global ranking has led to the transformation in the governance structure, the funding scheme, the curriculum and the academic profession in higher education.
there is a need for more studies on the impact of the current global higher education transformations on teaching, learning and the academic profession in Asian universities.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following: What are the major transformations in the higher education system in the context of global competitiveness in Asia?
how higher education systems in different parts of the world have responded to the challenge of globalization and the knowledge-based economy.
how the global university ranking has impacted the academic profession in the region.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the impact on the academic professions in Asia is not yet fully known.
there is no one-size-fits-all approach in the quest for global ranking, but a variety of approaches and measures are being adopted by different universities.
there has been a significant change in the higher education systems of Asian countries.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the higher education transformations for enhancing global competitiveness have led to major changes in the policy environment for higher education in Asia, and the impact on the academic professions in the region is significant, especially when the pressure to achieve global ranking is on the agenda.
, in the process of transforming higher education systems for global competitiveness, the social and professional consequences are far more profound than the policy intentions.
the global university ranking system is not only an important indicator to measure the quality of universities, but is also an important tool in the global competition for resources and status.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the global university ranking is an important indicator for measuring the performance of universities in the knowledge economy and it has a strong influence in shaping the higher education transformations for the global competitiveness in Asia.
while global university ranking may be useful for the internationalization of higher education, it is not a sufficient indicator of the quality of higher education in Asia.

the quest for global competitiveness is leading to a transformation of higher education in Asia, with the academic profession in the region facing a number of challenges, which are likely to be intensified as the quest for global rankings continues.
